THE SRI LANKA ARMED SERVICES LONG SERVICE MEDAL AND CLASP

IT is hereby notified that His Excellency the President has been pleased to award the Sri Lanka Armed Services LongService Medal & Clasp to the persons specified in the Schedule hereto.

By His Excellency’s Command,

HEMASIRI FERNANDO,Secretary,Ministry of Defence.At Colombo.
